turns.speaker: Marcus Hale
turns.text: Is the Halberg thesis even prior art? What do we need to attack its public accessibility?

Halberg is a 2017 M.S. thesis, so it predates the '907's 2019 priority date, but it is prior art under 102(a)(1) only if it was publicly accessible before the critical date. Under In re Klopfenstein, 380 F.3d 1345 (Fed. Cir. 2004), and Kyocera Wireless Corp. v. ITC [VERIFY], the question is whether an interested skilled artisan exercising reasonable diligence could locate it. Attack points: (1) when it was catalogued and indexed in the Tampere library (catalog record date, not the defense date); (2) whether it was shelved or only available on request; (3) whether the online repository allowed keyword search before 2019. Serve a targeted interrogatory and a document subpoena for the library's cataloguing records; In re Cronyn (Fed. Cir. 1989) is our best case on non-indexed theses.

Rejection 1 (103, Tanaka + Brandt): (1) Strongest: Tanaka's phase correction is open-loop. Its 1.5 kHz routine replays a factory lookup table (Tanaka [0063]-[0065]) and never measures emitter output, so it doesn't teach the claimed closed-loop calibration; Brandt's photodiode taps monitor power, not phase. turns.speaker: Marcus Hale
turns.text: With two IPRs pending, what's Kestrel's estoppel exposure in the district court if the Board issues final decisions?

Under 35 U.S.C. 315(e)(2), once the Board issues a final written decision on a claim, Kestrel is estopped in the district court from asserting that the claim is invalid on any ground it raised or reasonably could have raised in the IPR, i.e. patents and printed publications. Practically: Tanaka, Brandt and Novak-based obviousness would be estopped for any claim reaching a final written decision; the Halberg thesis likely too if it's a printed publication. System-art (e.g., a physical prior LiDAR product) is not estopped, though California Institute of Technology v. Broadcom, 25 F.4th 976 (Fed. Cir. 2022), broadened 'reasonably could have raised'. Estoppel only attaches on final written decisions, and only for instituted claims.

Pair Pruitt's testimony with notice from the complaint (post-suit willfulness) and the fact that Kestrel continued and expanded sales (K9X launch) after service.
